title: geranium elatum
intro: Geranium elatum, commonly known as Mountain Geranium, is a perennial plant species belonging to the family Geraniaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body and mind. The therapeutic actions of Geranium elatum include its use as a natural remedy for anxiety, insomnia, and skin issues, due to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The plant's bioactive constituents, including geraniin, geranin, and geraniol, are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in herbal remedies and aromatherapy.
